title: I made a 32" Digital eInk Newspaper
summary: A short project video in which Greg Raiz turns a 32-inch eInk display into a wireless digital newspaper showing daily front pages. It runs for months on battery, and the code is published on GitHub.
why: HN commenters cite it as inspiration for large eInk displays and their own DIY projects.

quote.text: Some guy created a rotating newspaper frame from it[3]. Looks quite amazing, and it has a 1 year battery life.
